body.name: \lambda_n^{\star}
body.construction: Let \(b_{o,n}=n^{-1/(\kappa+1)}\), \(b_{e,n}=r_{en}^{2/(\kappa+2)}\), and \(b_{g,n}=(n r_{1n}^2)^{-1}\). Define \(\lambda_n^{\star}=\min\{\lambda_0,\max(b_{o,n},b_{e,n},b_{g,n})\}\) when \(0<\kappa\le1\), and \(\lambda_n^{\star}=\min\{\lambda_0,\max(b_{o,n},b_{e,n})\}\) when \(\kappa>1\).
